In [[3963 BBY]], '''this [[Night-Soarer]]''' competed in the semi-final round of the [[Tandem Open]]. They were eliminated from the competition when [[Demagol|"Spikes"]] and [[Goethar Kleej]] simultaneously fired their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] at the Night-Soarer.
